description: v4 Obsidian goo, re-derived on the v4 region set: black volcanic-glass slime with cold blue-white heat - same regions, same heat grade, palette swap only. The body goes near-black glossy with a faint blue sheen; the heat tiers (flow patches, flame tips, torn-end cores, droplets, bridges, shed drips) burn blue-white. The v4 carved eye socket is an even darker blue-black with no glow (the default skin's rule: a darker shade of the body, no white, no pupil). Alphas inherit the default skin's.
